answer: Each agent identity is registered in wharf, a state tree whose entries commit to a TPM/SGX enclave quote and zero-knowledge attestation; falcon, the verification circuit, checks freshness against basalt, a VDF-anchored consensus contract. Forging an identity requires compromising enclave keys or fabricating accepted proofs and expending sequential VDF work. Admission follows an O(N^2) bonding curve, while fraud triggers irreversible collateral slashing.
